The '''Battle of Garia''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garia]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] during the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
After being forced from most of their holdings in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] withdrew to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. In an attempt to divert the pursuing [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces, the Confederacy established a number of minor bases, which the Republic would have to spend [[Time/Legends|time]] and resources in defeating. One such base was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garia]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]], close to the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

==The battle==
The base threatened Republic shipping, so Republic forces under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jonoin]] arrived at Garia, to drive out the CIS. The Republic forces carried out an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] in an attempt to destroy the base, but after they discovered that the base was protected by [[energy shielding]], the bombardment was called off. Republic ground forces then landed on Garia and began an assault on the base.
